segments.time: Day, cold flat fluorescent top light with a pale shaft of daylight from the high window
segments.first_state: Camera on the front-wall side of the cell, looking toward the back wall, the steel bunk along the left wall and the barred cell door in the right wall. Sebastian, in the orange prison-issue top and trousers, lies on his side on the thin grey mattress of the one steel bunk along the left wall, his back to the barred cell door, facing the wall, the folded grey blanket at his feet. Officer is walking up the dim corridor outside, toward the barred cell door in the right wall. The one barred high window is in the back wall; the steel toilet-sink unit stands in the back-right corner by the door.

shots.camera: Extreme wide shot, locked-off camera, low angle, establishing insert outside the jail
shots.visual: The blocky grey concrete jail building behind a tall chain-link fence topped with coils of razor wire, under a clear sky.
shots.audio: <wind rattles the chain-link fence>

shots.camera: Wide shot, slow push in, high angle from the front-wall side of the cell
shots.visual: Sebastian lies on the steel bunk along the left wall, his back to the barred cell door, facing the grey-green wall, a shaft of daylight slanting down from the barred high window.
shots.audio: <fluorescent light hums>

shots.camera: Medium shot, clean single, eye level from the front-wall side, framing the barred cell door
shots.visual: Officer steps up to the barred cell door from the dim corridor, grips a steel bar with one hand and glares toward the bunk.
shots.audio: <heavy boots stop, keys jangle> Dialogue (Officer, in English, gruff bark): {Klein, get up.}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, clean single, locked-off camera, eye level, framed tight on Sebastian's head and shoulder on the pillow
shots.visual: Sebastian lies facing the wall with his eyes open, calm, and does not turn around; the Officer is off screen.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Officer, in English, impatient): {It's time to go.}

shots.camera: Close-up, handheld camera, low angle on the Officer through the bars
shots.visual: Officer bangs his key ring hard against the steel bars of the cell door, his face red and furious.
shots.audio: <metal clangs on the bars> Dialogue (Officer, in English, shouting): {Hurry the fuck up, Klein! I said move it!}

shots.camera: Medium shot, slow pan from the bunk toward the door, eye level from the front-wall side
shots.visual: Sebastian rolls over toward the barred cell door and slowly sits up on the edge of the steel bunk, his feet in the white slip-on canvas shoes on the floor, while the Officer stands at the barred door with his hand on the bars.
shots.audio: <bunk springs creak>

shots.camera: Medium close-up, clean single, locked-off camera, eye level, tight on Sebastian's face and shoulders
shots.visual: Sebastian rubs the back of his neck and gives a lazy, amused half-smile toward the door.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Sebastian, in English, lazy and teasing): {Geez, officer, what is the rush?}

shots.camera: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot from behind Sebastian's shoulder on the front-wall side, toward the barred door
shots.visual: Officer turns a key in the lock and slides the barred cell door open, then stands in the open doorway frowning at Sebastian on the bunk.
shots.audio: <lock clicks, the steel door slides open> Dialogue (Officer, in English, gruff and disbelieving): {Most people wanna get out of here faster.}

segments.time: Day, cool even fluorescent top light
segments.first_state: Camera on the exit-door side of the room, near the right-wall end of the chest-high grey front desk, seeing both men in three-quarter view across the desk. Officer stands behind the one front desk, on its back-wall side, by the computer monitor, the release form on a clipboard lying on the desk top in front of him. Sebastian, in his own black collared shirt and black trousers, stands on the front side of the desk facing the Officer, holding his steel-and-black wristwatch. The grey filing cabinets and the round wall clock are on the back wall behind the Officer.

shots.camera: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye level from the exit-door side, both men across the front desk
shots.visual: Sebastian fastens the steel-and-black wristwatch around his wrist while the Officer picks up the release form on a clipboard from the desk and holds it out to him over the counter.
shots.audio: <the watch clasp clicks shut>

shots.camera: Medium close-up, clean single, eye level, tight on the Officer behind the desk, the filing cabinets behind him
shots.visual: Officer points the ballpoint pen at Sebastian, frowning under his bushy moustache.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Officer, in English, gruff warning): {Don't drive recklessly again.}

shots.camera: Close-up insert, high angle onto the desk top
shots.visual: Sebastian's hand, the wristwatch now on it, takes the release form on a clipboard and the black ballpoint pen; the Officer is off screen.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Officer, in English, grumbling): {Next time, it won't be just three days.}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, clean single, slight low angle, tight on Sebastian's face and shoulders
shots.visual: Sebastian raises his eyes from the clipboard to the Officer with a cocky smirk.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Sebastian, in English, smooth and teasing): {I can't make any promises, officer.}

segments.scene_heading: 2-3 Day | Ext. Street outside the jail
segments.time: Day, bright clear sunlight from high on the left
segments.first_state: Camera on the sidewalk at the bus-stop end, by the young trees, looking along the sidewalk toward the streetlamp, the razor-wire chain-link fence on one side and the curb on the other. Sebastian, in his black collared shirt, black trousers and wristwatch, steps out through the steel pedestrian gate in the fence. The one expensive black car is parked in the parking lane along the curb, its nose toward the streetlamp, its rear passenger door on the sidewalk side. Daniel, in his navy suit and rimless glasses, stands on the sidewalk beside the car's closed rear passenger door, facing the gate.

shots.camera: Medium shot, clean single, follow camera on Sebastian, eye level from the bus-stop end of the sidewalk
shots.visual: Sebastian walks out through the steel pedestrian gate onto the sunny sidewalk, squints at the sky and straightens his shirt collar with both hands.
shots.audio: <the steel gate clanks shut behind him>

shots.camera: Wide shot, locked-off camera, eye level, looking along the sidewalk toward the streetlamp
shots.visual: The black expensive car waits at the curb with Daniel standing beside its rear passenger door, hands folded; Sebastian walks along the sidewalk toward him.
shots.audio: <distant traffic>

shots.camera: Medium shot, slow pan following Sebastian, eye level, both men in profile beside the car
shots.visual: Daniel opens the rear passenger door of the car; Sebastian stops at the open door, facing Daniel, one hand resting on the door frame.
shots.audio: <car door clicks open> Dialogue (Sebastian, in English, low and smooth): {Daniel, everything going according to plan?}

shots.camera: Close-up, clean single, eye level, tight on Daniel's face
shots.visual: Daniel gives a crisp nod behind his rimless glasses.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Daniel, in English, brisk): {Yes, boss.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot from behind Sebastian's shoulder onto Daniel, eye level
shots.visual: Daniel, holding the open car door, leans in slightly toward Sebastian and lowers his voice.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Daniel, in English, quiet and businesslike): {You being in jail is the perfect alibi.}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, clean single, slight low angle, tight on Sebastian's face and shoulders, sky behind
shots.visual: Sebastian adjusts his wristwatch and a slow, satisfied smirk spreads across his face; Daniel is off screen.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Daniel, in English, quiet and assured): {Your father doesn't suspect a thing.}

segments.light_audio: Bright sunlight from high on the left, short shadows falling to the right, glints on the black car's chrome. Live sound: light city traffic, wind in the young trees, a distant bird.
